info.description: The Hotel Room Inventory API provides access to the availability and details of hotel rooms in the inventory. It allows consumers to retrieve comprehensive information about room types, status, and pricing. Key use cases include integrating with booking systems, managing property listings, and facilitating reservations by third-party applications. This API is essential for hotels and travel platforms aiming to enhance their service offerings by providing up-to-date room information.

get.summary: Retrieve the current inventory of rooms.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current inventory of available rooms. It provides detailed information about each room, including availability status, types, and pricing. This is useful for managing bookings and understanding room availability.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the inventory of rooms. This body may include various filters or parameters as specified in the schema, enhancing the ability to query the available room inventory based on specific criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the room inventory data.

ListHotelRoomsInventorysRequest.title: Get Rooms Inventory Request Body
